nodes.label: Config-as-Package Pattern

This is the default Turborepo pattern and must be merged or left in place depending on whether the destination already has root configs.

nodes.label: CFBD Import Endpoints

nodes.label: importJobs

nodes.label: CFBD conference=SEC Scope
nodes.rationale: GET games with conference=SEC returns every game with an SEC team on either side, including non-conference opponents, not SEC-vs-SEC only.

nodes.label: Dropped Derby Identity Tables
nodes.rationale: PCKM_GROUP, passwords and SHA-256, sequences, JPA metamodel, and SQL joins are dropped. No historical Derby data is migrated.

nodes.label: Registration Dropped
nodes.rationale: No RegistrationService and no email/password. Google sign-in provisions users. Account no longer has old/new/confirm password.

nodes.label: Intentionally Not Ported
nodes.rationale: Password registration, group tables, sequences, Derby/JPA/EJB/Struts, and browser calls to a Java origin are not ported.

nodes.label: Frontend oxfmt Style
nodes.rationale: Single quotes, no semicolons, @/ alias, sorted imports. Format and lint from apps/frontend with oxfmt and oxlint.

nodes.label: Base UI Controls
nodes.rationale: Interactive controls use @base-ui/react. Links compose via the render prop. Tables, headings, and plain text stay semantic HTML.

nodes.label: Confidence Pick'em
nodes.rationale: Each week a player picks a winner for every matchup and assigns rank 1..N. A correct pick earns its rank. Managers CRUD reference and schedule data.

nodes.label: Game Rules
nodes.rationale: Manager sets up the season. Player ranks picks from N down to 1. Correct picks earn the rank; wrong picks earn 0. Leaderboard is the season total. Picks lock at week begin.

nodes.label: Legacy Struts WAR

nodes.label: Greenfield Behavior-Preserving Rewrite
nodes.rationale: Not an in-place refactor. Nothing in src/main is modified. Legacy tree stays until parity is verified, then is removed.

nodes.label: Auth Me and Logout

nodes.label: API Error Shape
nodes.rationale: 400 validation, 401 session, 403 missing manager or browser hitting internal, 409 stale version or pick lock or referenced delete, 202 import accepted, 503 CFBD failure.

nodes.label: Firebase Role Matrix
nodes.rationale: No role may only POST /api/auth/session. player may call auth and game. manager may also call manager. Players are blocked from /api/manager.

nodes.label: Team Schedule API

nodes.label: Idempotent Seed Re-run

nodes.label: Predecessor Done Gate
nodes.rationale: Done means the index Status cell is exactly Done. Gate on the union of index Predecessors and the section Predecessors line, expanding ranges. Stop before branching if any predecessor is open.

nodes.label: Implementation Order Gate
nodes.rationale: Follow user-stories.md. US-02 is architecture docs. US-13 can follow US-01. Backend platform US-03 needs US-01 and US-02. Do not pull later stories into a PR.

nodes.label: Blocked Deletes
nodes.rationale: Deletes return 409 while children or references exist. No cascade of picks.

nodes.label: Weekly Picks API
nodes.rationale: GET /api/game/main and POST /api/game/picks. Empty picks are dropped. Ranks must be unique. A locked week is 409 or 400. A player cannot write another user's picks.

nodes.label: Leaderboard API
nodes.rationale: GET /api/game/leaderboard returns standings sorted by score descending, tie-break uid ascending. Future weeks and unscored games add 0. Users with no picks appear at 0.

nodes.label: matchups
nodes.rationale: Replaces PCKM_MATCHUP and the denormalized Test.sql join. Read-heavy picks grid document. winningTeamId is server-computed. Optional unique cfbdGameId is the idempotent upsert key.

nodes.label: picks
nodes.rationale: Replaces PCKM_USER_PICK. One document per user per matchup. Rank is 1..N where N is conference team count and unique per user per week. A correct pick earns its rank.

nodes.label: rivalries
nodes.rationale: Replaces PCKM_RIVALRY. Embeds both team snapshots. team1.id must differ from team2.id.

nodes.label: seasonWeeks
nodes.rationale: Replaces PCKM_SEASON_WEEK. Manual CRUD is Thursday begin and Wednesday end. CFBD import upserts weeks from GET /calendar and is not subject to that rule.

nodes.label: teams
nodes.rationale: Replaces PCKM_TEAM. Embeds homeVenue snapshot and keeps homeVenueId. The 16 SEC schools are conferenceMember true and must have cfbdTeamId before import.

nodes.label: venues
nodes.rationale: Replaces PCKM_VENUE. Optional unique cfbdVenueId. A seeded Unknown venue is used when import cannot resolve a home venue.

nodes.label: LeaderboardService
nodes.rationale: Scoring engine replacing LeaderBoardAction. Sums rank where pickedTeamId equals winningTeamId, sorts descending, tie-breaks by userId.

nodes.label: MatchupService
nodes.rationale: Replaces MatchupBean. Loads season matchups and user picks and joins them in code. No SQL.

nodes.label: PickService
nodes.rationale: Replaces MainAction.save and UserPickBean.persistList. Bulk upsert of weekly picks; drops empty picks.

nodes.rationale: Game-day timezone is America/New_York. Manual week CRUD is Thursday-Wednesday; CFBD weeks come from GET /calendar.

nodes.label: Pick Lock at Week Begin
nodes.rationale: Once a week's beginDate is today or past, that week's picks cannot be saved. Results show for current and past weeks only.

nodes.label: Ties Invalid
nodes.rationale: Equal home and away scores are HTTP 400. winningTeamId requires a strict winner. College football ties are invalid.

nodes.label: Environment vs Code Failure Recognition
nodes.rationale: Missing binaries, OOM, permission errors, network failures, and container issues are environment failures and must bail without consuming the local-fix gate budget. Compilation, test, lint, and type errors are code failures and may proceed through the gate.

nodes.label: Git Safety Staging
nodes.rationale: Stage specific files by name. git add -A or git add . can commit unrelated work-in-progress or secrets.

nodes.label: CI Monitoring Anti-Patterns
nodes.rationale: Provider CLIs with watch flags, custom polling, cancelling pipelines, and fixing CI on the main agent while polling race Nx Cloud self-healing, lose progress, or waste context. Prefer this skill over gh or glab because those tools cannot access self-healing.

nodes.label: Generator directory Flag Is the Full Path
nodes.norm_label: generator directory flag is the full path

nodes.label: Package Manager Hoisting Differences
nodes.rationale: npm and bun hoist shared dependencies to the root node_modules. pnpm does not hoist, which prevents phantom dependencies. Yarn Berry uses Plug'n'Play and has no node_modules by default. Do not paper over missing links with tsconfig paths.

nodes.label: Private Root package.json
nodes.rationale: The root package.json should set private true so the workspace root is not accidentally published.

nodes.label: Non-Buildable Library Default
nodes.rationale: Internal libraries should be non-buildable so consumers compile source directly, which is simpler and faster. Buildable libraries with vite or swc are for publishing, cross-repo sharing, or stable cache hits.

nodes.label: Prefer Local Workspace Generators
nodes.rationale: When both a local workspace generator and an external plugin generator could satisfy the request, prefer the local one because it is customized to the repository's patterns.

nodes.label: Subdirectory-at-a-Time Import
nodes.rationale: For monorepo sources, import one directory at a time so files land at the top level without nested nx.json and tsconfig.base.json. Root dependencies, plugins, and targetDefaults are not imported and must be merged separately. Whole-repo import is only for single-project repos.

nodes.label: Account and Theme Picker API
nodes.rationale: GET/PUT /api/game/account updates nickName and themeId only. Password field names are 400. GET /api/game/themes returns active catalog themes in catalog order.

nodes.label: POST /api/auth/session
nodes.rationale: Verifies a Google ID token, provisions or refreshes users, and mints an __session cookie of about 5 to 14 days. No registration and no password fields.

nodes.label: themes
nodes.rationale: Replaces PCKM_THEME. Closed catalog of 18 palettes. Hex and keys come from sec-theme-colors.md. Inactive themes are hidden from the account picker.

nodes.label: users
nodes.rationale: Replaces PCKM_USER. Document id is the Firebase uid. No password. roles mirrors custom claims. nickName and themeId stay user-owned across sign-in.

nodes.label: Firebase Auth Flow
nodes.rationale: Google ID token is posted once to Next.js /api/auth/session. Spring provisions users, sets player if new, and mints a session cookie. Middleware verifies the cookie with Firebase Admin.

nodes.label: SessionCookieFilter
nodes.rationale: Reads the forwarded __session cookie and verifies it with Firebase Admin verifySessionCookie checkRevoked true. Roles come from custom claims. Replaces web.xml constraints and LoginFilter.

nodes.label: Eighteen Theme Catalog
nodes.rationale: Closed catalog of 18 themes. themePath is the theme key and must not begin with /. Default is light. Users on a deactivated theme keep it until they pick another.

nodes.label: Success and Danger Pick Icons
nodes.rationale: Correct and incorrect pick icons always use --color-success and --color-danger, not school colors.

nodes.label: Semantic Color Tokens
nodes.rationale: Every theme supplies CSS custom properties from --color-bg through --color-danger. Components use semantic utilities and never hard-code a hex. Selector is [data-theme] on html.

nodes.label: Local Firebase Emulators
nodes.rationale: Auth emulator is 127.0.0.1:9099. Firestore emulator is 127.0.0.1:8085 so it does not collide with Spring on 8080. Backend tests use Testcontainers.

nodes.label: Bootstrap Manager
nodes.rationale: When the email matches a Firebase Auth user, seed sets player and manager claims and upserts users/{uid}. If the user is missing, reference data is written and the process exits 1. Seed never creates a password user.

nodes.label: SeedMain
nodes.rationale: Entry points tools/seed/seed.cmd and tools/seed/seed run SeedMain through the Maven wrapper. Loads SEC venues, teams, rivalries, the 2026 sample season, 18 themes, and an optional bootstrap manager.

nodes.label: Closed Set of 18 Themes
nodes.rationale: Eighteen compiled palettes: Light, Dark, and 16 SEC schools. Admin may activate, deactivate, and rename only.

nodes.label: Default Theme Light
nodes.rationale: Default themeId is light. prefers-color-scheme may later switch the Light/Dark pair on first visit but is not the default.

nodes.label: Open Google Sign-in
nodes.rationale: Any Google account may sign in. First sign-in auto-assigns the player claim and creates a users document. Not a domain allowlist.

nodes.label: HttpOnly Session Cookie
nodes.rationale: Auth uses an HttpOnly __session cookie minted by Firebase Admin createSessionCookie, not a per-request Bearer token.

nodes.label: Secret Sources
nodes.rationale: Spring reads OS environment, a .env file, or Google Secret Manager (sm@). Existing environment variables win over .env. Do not commit .env.

nodes.label: Background CFBD Import
nodes.rationale: Import is a background job plus UI poll (202 plus job id), not one synchronous BFF POST. Regular season is default; postseason is optional.

nodes.label: Scores Only When Completed
nodes.rationale: Scores are written only when CFBD marks the game completed with both homePoints and awayPoints. No live in-progress scoring.

nodes.label: Server-only CFBD API Key
nodes.rationale: CFBD_API_KEY stays on the server. Calls go only from Spring to https://api.collegefootballdata.com.
